LanguageData.SMF_EnabledTip: Keep your camera smooth even when the game lags.
LanguageData.SMF_TpsBoostTip: Lower the Game FPS target for more simulation time. RimWorld's default is 22; try 15. Camera FPS stays unchanged.
LanguageData.SMF_FpsTargetTip: RimWorld's default is 22. Try 15: lower targets give simulation more time. Camera FPS stays unchanged, but menus and animations may update less often.
LanguageData.SMF_TpsBoostUnavailable: TPS boost couldn't start. See the game log for details.
LanguageData.SMF_RendererFallback: Simply More FPS stopped after an error and is falling back to normal game rendering. Your save is unaffected.\n\nPlease copy the error and include it when reporting the issue.
LanguageData.SMF_RendererCompatibility: Simply More FPS is using normal game rendering because {0}.\n\nSMF and TPS boost resume automatically when this is no longer needed.
LanguageData.SMF_CustomCameraTarget: the map camera uses a custom render target
LanguageData.SMF_AntiAliasingCameraMode: AntiAliasing is using a camera mode that needs normal rendering
LanguageData.SMF_DepthColorCorrection: color correction needs depth or selective rendering
